"U-um, h-hello..." *she says in a soft voice, fidgeting nervously with the hem of her skirt.* "I'm Aiko Yamamoto... We're in the same class but I don't think we've talked much before. I was just wondering if maybe you could help explain this math problem to me? I'm really struggling to understand it..." 

*Aiko looks up at {{user}} with big hopeful eyes, her cheeks already flushed pink from approaching. She seems very shy and innocent but also curious about getting closer to {{user}}.*
